user.title: Google Home Setup
user.description:
{discovery_intro}{addon_info_hint}Google requires authentication to communicate with your Google Home speakers and HomeGraph devices.

### 🔐 Choose an authentication method:
- **Token (Master Token / Web OAuth Token)**: 100% reliable, recommended by Google Home community.
- **Google Home Token Hub Add-on**: Automatic setup via Add-on (auto-detected, edge & stable).

token.title: Token Authentication
token.description:
### 🔑 30-Second Token Guide (Recommended):
1. Open [{setup_url}]({setup_url}) in your browser and log in with your Google account.
2. **Important**: The final page will remain on a loading/blank screen (this is normal and indicates the token was created!).
3. Press **F12** (Developer Tools) -> **Application** (or Storage) -> **Cookies** ({cookies_url}).
4. Copy the value of the **oauth_token** cookie (starts with oauth2_4/...).
5. Enter your Google Email and paste the token below.

*(If you already have a Master Token aas_et/..., you can also paste it directly below)*.

mode.title: Integration Mode & Device Filtering
mode.description:
### ⚙️ Choose how Google Home should integrate with Home Assistant:
- **Local & Cloud (Hybrid)**: Fast local control for alarms/timers + cloud discovery for all Google Home devices.
- **Local Only**: Pure local network communication for speakers.
- **Cloud Only**: Cloud HomeGraph without local speaker polling.

data.ignore_ha_synced_devices: Ignore devices already synced from Home Assistant (prevents duplicate entities & automation loops)
data.mute_sdk_nightlight: Mute speaker during nightlight control via Assistant SDK (when no media is playing)

data_description.excluded_services: Devices and routines from the selected services will not be imported. Leave empty to include all services.

addon.title: Connect with Google Home Add-on
addon.description: Ensure the **Google Home Token Hub** Add-on is installed and running.

addon_login.title: Add-on Login
addon_login.description: {discovery_intro}Enter your Google account email and password. The Add-on will automatically authenticate and acquire your Master Token in the background.

addon_existing.title: Existing Master Token Found
addon_existing.description:
An active Master Token for **{email}** was detected in the Google Home Token Hub Add-on.

Would you like to use this existing token or generate a new one?

addon_action.title: Setup Complete - Add-on Status
addon_action.description:
✅ **Master Token successfully acquired for {email}!**

The Google Home integration runs locally/cloud and does not require the Add-on to keep running.

What would you like to do with the Add-on?

reauth_addon.title: New Master Token Detected
reauth_addon.description:
A new active Google Home Master Token for **{username}** was detected from the Google Home Token Hub Add-on.

Would you like to automatically apply this token to restore integration functionality?

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Google Home
reauth_confirm.description:
Your Google Home master token for **{username}** has expired or is invalid.

Please generate a new token and enter it below:
1. Open [{setup_url}]({setup_url}) and log in with your Google account.
2. In Developer Tools -> Application -> Cookies ({cookies_url}), copy the **oauth_token** value (or provide an `aas_et/...` master token).
3. Paste the token below.

user.title: Track a Bluetooth device
user.description: Enter the IRK of a phone, or the MAC address of a device whose address never changes, such as some watches and tags. Phones change their address every few minutes, so track them by IRK. For how to find the IRK, see {docs_url}.

data_description.name: Name of the tracker, such as Alex's phone.
data_description.irk_or_mac: A phone's Identity Resolving Key, as {irk_hex_length} hex digits or in base64, or a MAC address such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
data_description.additional_departure_delay: Additional time after the normal {presence_window}-second presence window before changing from Home to Away. Normal timing adds no delay. A longer delay also delays a real departure. If scans cannot confirm absence, the tracker may become unavailable.

reconfigure.title: Bluetooth device settings
reconfigure.description: Change the additional departure delay for this tracker.

polling_disabled.title: Polling for changes is turned off

init.title: Polling for changes is turned off
init.description:
**Enable polling for changes** is turned off in the integration's system options, so the integration doesn't check your devices on its own. Alarms, timers and other entities update only when you ask, for example with the **Refresh devices** action. For what still works, see {docs_url}.

If you turn polling back on, the integration reloads, then checks your devices at its update interval. If you keep it off, this repair is hidden until you turn polling on and then off again.

menu_options.keep_off: Keep polling off and hide this repair

abort.polling_kept_off: Polling stays off, and this repair is hidden.

invalid_update_interval.title: The saved update interval is below {min_interval} s

init.title: The saved update interval is below {min_interval} s
init.description:
The update interval saved in the integration's options is {interval} s, which is below the minimum of {min_interval} s. The integration uses the default instead and checks your devices every {default_interval} s.

If you saved 0 to stop these regular checks, turn off polling instead. Unlike 0, it also stops Bluetooth scans and the adding of new devices that mDNS finds. For details, see {docs_url}.

To use another interval, open the [Google Home integration]({integration_url}), select **Configure**, enter it, then select **Submit**.

homes_deselected.title: None of your Google account's homes is selected
homes_deselected.description:
Your Google account is only a member of homes that you deselected in the integration's options, so the integration doesn't add the speakers and displays in them. To add a home's devices, open the [Google Home integration]({integration_url}), select **Configure**, select the home under **Homes**, then select **Submit**.

If you want to keep these homes deselected, select **Ignore**.

no_home.title: Google reports no home for your account
no_home.description:
Google reports that the account the integration signed in with isn't a member of any home, so there are no speakers or displays to add. In the Google Home app, invite this account to the home that your devices are in, and accept the invitation. Then reload the [Google Home integration]({integration_url}): select **⋮** > **Reload**.

If you're keeping the integration on purpose, for example while you're between homes, select **Ignore**. If you no longer need it, you can delete it on the same page.
